title: singular.orchestration.ctx-experiment-attempts.v0
description: Secondary raw-metrics artifact the operator's experiment-report.md references at merge alongside the ctx-experiment-report.v0 and ctx-experiment-strategy.v0 artifacts: the LAST remaining stage-7 secondary metrics — per-arm attempts-to-accept and findings-per-attempt. Computed read-only from the runs directory attempts indexes (runs/<runId>/attempts/index.json) joined per arm via ctx.arm_assigned in the events log. An attempt is accepted when its failureClass is one of empty / 'accepted' / 'none' (the ctx-metrics.v0 convention verbatim). Keys are sorted and deterministic for a fixed input set.

attemptsToAccept.description: Per-arm attempts-to-accept: over each arm's tasks that were ever accepted, the ordinal of each task's FIRST accepted attempt. Both arms (A = control / M0 knob-state, B = treatment) are always present.

findingsPerAttempt.description: Per-arm findings-per-attempt: over each arm's attempt entries, the total findings-array length divided by the number of attempts. Both arms always present.
